tools.name: manual-sbom-author
tools.comment: Manual CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM authored for v0.1.0 OSS release. v0.1.0 ships ZERO direct runtime dependencies per architect non-goal RC-20 (see API.md and docs/threat-model-v0.1.0.md OH-3). Syft was unavailable at SBOM-generation time; this hand-authored SBOM accurately reflects the dependency-free composition. At v0.2.0 (SDK bindings phase) the SBOM MUST be regenerated via Syft per CISA 2025 minimum elements. Install: `brew install syft` or `curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anchore/syft/main/install.sh | sh`.

component.name: conductor-kernel
component.description: Domain-agnostic orchestration kernel for multi-agent workflows in Claude Code. Exports orchestration primitives, validators, security agents, and supporting skills consumed by domain plugins.

hashes.content: <TBD: computed at release tag from git archive>

compositions.comment: Composition is COMPLETE — the kernel ships with NO bundled or transitive direct runtime dependencies. The kernel comprises Markdown agent/skill definitions, JSON Schema state contracts, and Bash verification scripts. Tooling such as `gitleaks` (security scan), `syft` (SBOM generation, future), `jq` (script utility), and `sqlite3` (audit.db reader, optional) are OPERATOR-PROVIDED environment dependencies, not bundled with the kernel.
